pull_requests.title: Prototype a Postgres-backed worker lease
pull_requests.summary: Adds idempotent job claims using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and reclaims expired sixty-second leases.
checks: sustained 250 jobs per hour on the pilot fixture
pull_requests.review: Approved for pilot scale. Revisit when measured throughput or isolation requirements exceed this design.

pull_requests.title: Evaluate StreamForge broker
pull_requests.summary: A broker prototype sustained 5000 jobs per hour but introduced three services, a separate backup path, and an estimated GBP 260 monthly pilot cost.
pull_requests.review: Closed without merge because pilot throughput does not justify the operational and cost increase.
